summary.text:
# 行商：本地特许权 / Caravaneers: Local Franchise

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany

## 如何开始 How it starts

每年的行商随机事件（on_action on_yearly_random_pulse_country_caravaneers_list，由 action.2001 每年触发；权重 4000/4010/4020 各1，4030/4040/4050 各2，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:443-451）。需要国境内有行商车队所在的殖民地系统（caravaneer_fleet_events_valid）；全局冷却：任一行商事件后720天内不再触发（flag caravan_recent_event），该事件自己还有10年冷却。 本事件条件：同系有行商车队、300+人口的殖民地，且之前10年内没有同类事件；非集群。

Yearly random caravaneer events (on_action on_yearly_random_pulse_country_caravaneers_list, fired yearly via action.2001; weights 4000/4010/4020 = 1 each, 4030/4040/4050 = 2 each, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:443-451). Needs a caravaneer fleet in a colonised system inside the borders (caravaneer_fleet_events_valid); a global cooldown of 720 days after any caravaneer event (flag caravan_recent_event) and a 10-year cooldown per event. This event needs: A colony of 300+ pops with a caravaneer fleet in the system and no such event in the last 10 years; non-gestalt.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

接受（需允许难民的政策）：该星球多出3个车队物种的人口群；拒绝：若是排外者获得30影响力。

Accept (needs a policy allowing refugees): the planet gains three pop groups of the fleet's species; refuse: xenophobes gain 30 influence.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

见上；没有进一步的分支。

See above; no further branches.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

接受选项要求 refugees_allowed 政策。

The accept option requires the refugees_allowed policy.

核对了脚本触发、冷却旗标与选项效果；它与同一池里的其他事件相互独立。

Trigger, cooldown flags and option effects were checked against the script; it is independent of the other events of the same pool.
